function: Multi-user hybrid beamforming: CNN predicts mmWave beamspace from sub-6G channel estimates, GNN selects analog beams, LMMSE sets the digital precoder; objective is sum spectrum efficiency (pp. 4-8).
system: Dual-band multi-user: mmWave 28 GHz (BS 64 antennas, hybrid; UE 8) and sub-6G 3.5 GHz (BS 16, UE 4 antennas); up to 32 UEs; no RIS (pp. 3, 10).
method: Supervised 2D CNN (NMSE loss) for beamspace prediction, then unsupervised multi-layer GNN with a surrogate spectral-efficiency loss, CNN frozen; offline two-step training (pp. 8-9).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing 'O1' scenario at 28 and 3.5 GHz; Region 1: 200,000 samples for the CNN, 24,000 multi-user samples for the GNN, split 0.4:0.1:0.5 (pp. 3, 9-10).
test_conditions: Trained for 8 UEs in Region 1 at 20 dBm pilot power; tested on unseen Regions 2 and 3 and on pilot powers 0-20 dBm (pp. 11-12).
baselines: Non-learned: uncoordinated and coordinated beam selection [25], optimized hybrid beamforming with perfect CSI [9]; G(.) plus those selectors (own CNN, ablation); no earlier learned method compared (pp. 10-13).
metrics: Sum spectrum efficiency, NMSE of predicted beamspace, number of mmWave pilots, share of perfect-CSI upper bound, execution time (pp. 11-14).
complexity: Big-O: SA-MUHBF O((K^2 T + K T_G) Nz Nw + N_RF^3), baselines O(K Nz Nw + N_RF^3); measured 5 times faster than the uncoordinated method at 12 UEs (pp. 13-14).
openness: none (uses the public DeepMIMO dataset; no link to its own code or data, p. 9)
q1_support: p. 3: "we adopt the DeepMIMO dataset [33], [34] for network training" (ray tracing at sub-6G and mmWave); same dataset for testing, p. 9.
q2_support: p. 12: "SA-MUHBF is trained for the 8 UEs setup in Region 1" and "utilizing samples from Region 2 and Region 3 (see Fig. 7 for illustration) as testing samples".
q3_support: p. 10: "we first introduce two baselines from [25]" and "we also consider the integration of mmWave beamspace prediction network G(·) with the above two baselines" - non-learned baselines exist, but the learned ones reuse the paper's own CNN (an ablation); no earlier learned method is compared.
q4_support: p. 13: "the analog beam selection S(·) has a complexity on the order of O(K 2 Nz Nw T )"; p. 14: "in a scenario with 12 UEs, SA-MUHBF is 5 times faster than the" uncoordinated method.
q5_support: p. 9: "to evaluate the proposed SA-MUHBF based on the DeepMIMO dataset [33], [34]" - public ray-tracing channels; the paper gives no link to its own code.
notes: PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint (2403.10873v2) titled 'CSI Transfer From Sub-6G to mmWave: Reduced-Overhead Multi-User Hybrid Beamforming'; the DOI is not printed in it, matched by topic and venue. Area 3 rather than 2: the main metric is sum spectrum efficiency (pp. 11-13) and the CNN beamspace prediction (NMSE 0.0894) is an intermediate step. q3 is 0 because the only learned comparisons, G(.)+uncoordinated and G(.)+coordinated, keep the proposed CNN and replace only the GNN; the GNNs of [31] and [37] are discussed on p. 8 but not simulated. q2: the antenna-configuration study retrains separate models (p. 12) and the pilot-power sweep is an SNR sweep, so neither counts; the unseen-region test counts. Fig. 12 caption says BS 16 for Region 3 while p. 9 lists BS 15. 'After fine-tuning G(.)' on p. 11 is not explained. q1 and q5 rest on DeepMIMO ray tracing (confirm).
